name: Dense Bone
description: Pack metal qi into the long bones so that a club or a kick breaks on them.

name: Adamant Fist
description: Close a fist so dense with metal qi that it cracks a foe's shield or ribs on contact.

name: Weight Sink
description: Let the body grow heavy through the legs and trunk so that no throw, shove or sweep can lift the user.

name: Mass Reading
description: Press a palm to a foe's armor or weapon and read through metal qi how much it weighs and how it is balanced.

name: Heavy Step
description: Drive each footfall into the ground with dense weight and advance against a press that would push a lighter body back.

name: Boneplate
description: Raise plates of metal qi inside the flesh along the ribs and spine and hold them there against a long beating.

name: Massdrive
description: Throw the user's dense body forward in one blow so that the weight, not the speed, breaks the foe's stance.

name: Weightbind
description: Lay a heavy arm across a foe and add the dense weight of metal qi until he cannot rise or twist.

name: Immovable Frame
description: Lock the whole skeleton in metal qi so the user holds a stance against a charge of several strong bodies.

name: Adamant Crush
description: Swing a single dense blow with the whole of the user's weight that sends a heavily armored foe flying.

name: Adamant Body
description: Turn the entire body to adamant metal for as long as the stance is held, so that no blade or blow below the same grade can mark it, at the price of speed.

name: Falling Edge
description: Loose a single blade of metal qi from above so that it falls on one foe's shoulder.

name: Overhead Blade
description: Bring a long blade of qi down in a heavy overhead cut on one foe's guard.

name: Edge Canopy
description: Hold a canopy of blades above the head to knock off falling stones, arrows and blades.

name: Blade Calling
description: Reach out into the air for the metal qi of blades unsheathed near the user, and count them.

name: Fallen Footing
description: Let a blade of qi fall to the ground and step off its flat as it strikes to bound away.

name: Bladefall
description: Drop a shower of blades on the foes standing in the space before the user.

name: Swordpin
description: Drive a falling blade through a foe's cloak or sleeve into the ground and hold him fixed.

name: Rainscreen
description: Keep a turning sheet of blades above and before the user to cut down missiles and flying debris.

name: Spearfall
description: Drop one long spear of metal qi from above into a single foe's armor.

name: Heavenly Edgefall
description: Call down a great mass of blades in a wide fall that cuts through guards and shields of all the foes beneath it.

name: Lance Descent
description: Plunge one huge lance of metal qi down on a single foe and through all he stands on.

name: Sword Deluge
description: Hold a flood of blades pouring from the air over a wide space for several breaths, so that nothing under it stands unwounded.

name: Metal Reach
description: Extend the awareness through all metal in the region about the user and feel how it lies and moves.

name: Iron Tug
description: Yank at the iron in a foe's mail so his arms are dragged out of line in the middle of a stroke.

name: Drawn Stride
description: Let a large mass of metal pull the user across in one fast draw.

name: Magnet Fist
description: Strike with a fist that draws the foe's armor in to meet it, so the blow lands with more force than the user threw.

name: Reachbind
description: Draw the metal on several foes toward one another so they are bound together by their own armor.

name: Ironswirl
description: Whirl loose iron about the user in a flying ring that strikes all that come near.

name: Weaponcall
description: Call every weapon within reach out of the hands that hold them and into a heap behind the user.

name: Armor Wrench
description: Wrench the plates of a foe's armor away from the body, tearing the straps and laying him open.

name: Hurled Iron
description: Draw a great mass of loose iron up and hurl it in one piece at a foe.

name: Lodestone Dominion
description: Command all metal in a wide ring about the user: weapons leave hands, armor clamps on its wearers and the iron ground itself holds the foes in place.

name: Iron Squire
description: Raise a small iron figure from the ground to strike one foe in the shin and fall apart.

name: Figure Guard
description: Stand a figure of metal qi between the user and an incoming blow to take the hit.

name: Wrought Lookout
description: Raise a tall figure of metal and see the surroundings through its eyes, for the user.

name: Squire Step
description: Make a figure that kneels, and use its back as a step to bound over a gap.

name: Figure Hurl
description: Throw a figure of metal qi bodily at one foe, to burst on impact.

name: Twin Squires
description: Raise two iron figures that fight side by side at one foe while the user holds the qi.

name: Pikemen
description: Raise a rank of figures with long pikes that thrust together at the foes before them.

name: Warden Figure
description: Plant a broad figure beside an ally or the user which turns blows aimed at them until it is broken.

name: Figure Snare
description: Raise figures that clasp a foe's arms and legs and hold him for a breath.

name: Wrought Advance
description: Send a front of armed iron figures forward at the foes, cutting a lane through them.

name: Bronze Sentinel
description: Raise a towering sentinel of bronze to stand guard over the user, taking the blows of several foes.

name: Colossal Fist
description: Raise a fist of metal as large as a cart and drive it down on a foe or a group of foes.

name: Wrought Host
description: Raise a whole host of armed figures of metal qi from the ground, which advance and fight on at the user's will until the qi runs out.

name: Star Needle
description: Loose a bright needle of metal qi that flies a long way straight at one foe.

name: Bright Point
description: Gather qi to a single bright point at the fingertip and jab it at one foe's eye or throat.

name: Narrow Guard
description: Meet a thrust on a single fine point of qi and push it aside by the width of a finger.

name: Seam Finding
description: Run the point along a foe's armor and read the narrowest gap in it, for the user.

name: Pointed Stride
description: Rise on the toes of a needle-fine footing and cross open ground in a swift line.

name: Starpierce
description: Narrow the point until it passes through shield and mail alike and into the body behind them.

name: Plate Rend
description: Drive the point into the gap of a foe's armor and twist so the plates part and the joint beneath is torn.

name: Spike Turn
description: Hold a needle-point before the chest and ride every thrust and bolt away from the user.

name: Piercing Star
description: Gather the qi to one white point and drive it through a heavy shield and the foe behind it.

name: Meteor Needle
description: Loose a needle at a speed that leaves a streak of light, striking a distant foe before he sees it leave.

name: Skyneedle
description: Draw all the qi the user can hold into one needle and loose it through armor, shield and wall, striking the one foe aimed at.

name: Concentric Ring
description: Spin rings of metal qi one inside another before the chest to take a blow on each in turn.

name: Ring Snap
description: Snap the outer ring outward against one foe's guard arm.

name: Ring Listening
description: Let the rings hum and read from the changes in their tone the presence of any weapon drawn near.

name: Twinring
description: Drop two rings round a foe's wrists and close them hard.

name: Ringcut
description: Spin a ring edge-on and cut through a foe's blade and arm with the rim.

name: Turning Rings
description: Maintain a stack of slowly turning rings about the body, each breaking a different kind of blow.

name: Nine Rings
description: Raise nine nested rings that absorb a blow layer by layer, one ring lost to each heavy strike.

name: Cutting Rings
description: Fling a flight of edge-on rings out in every direction to cut all the foes about the user.

name: Binding Rings
description: Close a hundred rings upon one powerful foe, locking limbs, weapon and qi flow within them until the rings are broken or the user lets go.

name: Wind Edge
description: Throw a razor of metal qi on the wind so it reaches a foe a long way off.

name: Gale Cut
description: Cut so fast that the air itself hisses and the edge arrives before the guard.

name: Windturn Guard
description: Turn the blade in a quick circle to ride an incoming stroke away on the wind it makes.

name: Air Tasting
description: Taste the air for the smell of hot iron and oil to learn where weapons and armor are carried.

name: Windcleave
description: Send a long thin blade of wind and metal qi through the line of foes before the user.

name: Edgeswirl
description: Spin in place with the blade out so a whirl of cutting wind spreads round the user.

name: Windglide
description: Ride the wind on a plate of metal qi and glide a great stride forward or aside.

name: Razor Current
description: Keep a stream of cutting wind flowing from the blade, slicing a foe's guard to ribbons as it passes.

name: Cutting Gust
description: Loose a violent burst of blade-wind in every direction at once.

name: Razor Gale
description: Raise a gale filled with metal edges that sweeps across a wide space and shreds the foes in its path.

name: Living Chain
description: Whip a chain of qi that moves as if alive across one foe's body.

name: Chainmail Ward
description: Wind chain qi round the body in loose coils to stop the cut or crush of a heavy blow.

name: Chain Coil
description: Coil a chain round a foe's leg and drop him.

name: Links Listening
description: Lay a chain across the ground and feel through it any step or tremor of a body drawing close.

name: Chain Leap
description: Vault by a chain fixed to a high point and swing over an obstacle.

name: Chain Shackle
description: Wind chain after chain round a foe until he cannot move, then keep them tight.

name: Chainfang
description: Strike with the pointed end of a chain like a snake's fang, through a gap in armor.

name: Chainspin
description: Spin four chains round the user as a whirling cage of blows against every foe at hand.

name: Linkguard
description: Throw a net of chain links in front of the user to snatch thrown weapons out of the air.

name: Hauling Chain
description: Seize a foe with a heavy chain and drag him bodily in whatever direction the user chooses.

name: Chain Maelstrom
description: Whirl a mass of chains in a vast storm about the user that smashes every foe within it.

name: Serpent Chain
description: Loose a great living chain that strikes, coils and crushes a single powerful foe, answering every effort to break free by tightening.

name: Bell Peal
description: Strike with a palm that rings like a bell, stunning one foe with the sound.

name: Bell Skin
description: Make the skin ring at the instant of a blow so the force of it scatters through the body.

name: Deep Toll
description: Sound a deep note of metal qi through the ground and read from its echo the shape of a large room.

name: Toll Stride
description: Strike a note through the heel and use the push of the sound to spring a long stride.

name: Bell Clapper
description: Swing the fist like a clapper against a foe's armor so the whole plate rings and rattles the body inside.

name: Bellring
description: Sound one cracking note that makes every foe nearby lose his grip on his weapon for a breath.

name: Tollwave
description: Send a ringing wave out from the body that pounds every foe in front of the user.

name: Bell Chime
description: Surround the user with a slowly sounding note that turns and scatters blows.

name: Deafening Peal
description: Ring a violent peal that leaves every foe nearby deaf, dizzy and unable to tell where the user stands.

name: Shattering Toll
description: Sound a note at the pitch of brittle metal so shields and weapons burst in the hands of all in front of the user.

name: Bellshock
description: Ring the whole body at once as a bell struck by a giant, sending a shock outward that breaks stances, qi flow and stone for a long reach.

name: Mercury Bead
description: Fling a heavy bead of mercury that breaks on one foe and runs into his guard.

name: Silver Sleeve
description: Let liquid silver run down the arm and set into a hard sleeve that takes a cut.

name: Bead Sling
description: Whirl liquid metal in a sling of qi and loose beads of it one after another at a foe.

name: Liquid Sensing
description: Send a thread of liquid metal into a lock, cage or hollow and learn its shape from the way it runs.

name: Mercury Skip
description: Run over a pool of liquid metal laid on the ground and skip across it without breaking its surface.

name: Silverrush
description: Dissolve the legs to liquid silver and rush past two foes before either can turn.

name: Mercuryspear
description: Harden a jet of liquid metal into a thin spear that pierces plate.

name: Mercuryveil
description: Spread a thin veil of flowing metal which turns blades aside as it flows over them.

name: Silverlock
description: Let liquid silver flow into the joints of a foe's armor and set hard.

name: Silver Cyclone
description: Whirl a cyclone of liquid silver about the user that flays all who stand within it.

name: Liquid Lance
description: Shoot a hard lance of liquid metal that bores through a shield and the foe behind it.

name: Mercury Skin
description: Wear a skin of liquid metal that flows over every wound and holds the user together under heavy blows.

name: Mercury Tempest
description: Raise a roaring tempest of liquid metal that scours a wide space, drowning, flaying and binding all that stands in it.

name: Bolt Draw
description: Pull a crossbow bolt or iron nail from the ground to the hand and fling it at a foe.

name: Grip Reading
description: Feel along the grip of a foe's metal weapon and read how firmly it is held.

name: Pole Step
description: Set a short iron pole in the ground, pull on it, and ride the pull in a fast arc.

name: Iron Pinch
description: Close the metal about a foe's wrists in a hard pinch.

name: Starhold
description: Hold a foe's weapon and armor against the pull of the lodestar until he cannot lift an arm.

name: Boltstorm
description: Draw every loose bolt and nail nearby into the air and send them flying at the foes before the user.

name: Plateward
description: Pull thrown weapons into the user's own plate and away from the body.

name: Seizing Hand
description: Close a great hand of metal qi round a foe in armor and crush the armor on him.

name: Rending Draw
description: Wrench a foe's metal gear violently toward a point so that it tears from him and strikes him on the way.

name: Lodestar Grasp
description: Turn the user into a lodestar whose pull draws all metal, armor, blade and bolt, onto one foe and holds him pinned beneath it.

name: Stilled Edge
description: Hold the blade perfectly still, then cut once, clean and without a wasted motion.

name: Calm Edge Guard
description: Meet a foe's blade with a point of perfect stillness and turn it off line.

name: Stillness Reading
description: Let the mind fall quiet and read the tension in a foe's blade hand from a few paces away.

name: Singlecut
description: Throw the whole body and qi into one cut, all else forgotten.

name: Muffled Step
description: Move across a room without a sound and arrive within the foe's reach.

name: Edgeveil
description: Draw a veil of dull metal qi over the blade so that it is not seen and not heard.

name: Perfect Cut
description: Make a single cut so true that it parts guard, shield and weapon without resistance.

name: Unseen Edge
description: Strike from a stance so still that the foe sees nothing before the edge is in him.

name: Final Edge
description: Hold the whole force of a life's practice in one motionless breath, then cut once in a way no guard and no armor can lessen.
